title: Workday HCM pricing - No published list price, employee-count tiered custom quotes
clean_text: Workday does not publish official list pricing; every contract is custom-quoted based on employee count, modules, complexity, integrations, compliance needs, and geography. Third-party pricing benchmarks report per-employee-per-year rates ranging roughly from $35 (25,000+ employee organizations) to $130 (1,000-2,500 employee organizations), with smaller organizations paying a higher per-employee rate. Other industry estimates cite $34-$42 per employee per month for companies at scale. Implementation costs are commonly reported at 100-150% of the first-year subscription fee.
